address: Het Wilhelmus 30 L, Maastricht, 6216 GK, Netherlands
bio: Rantrée welcomes you on the eighth floor of the Dormio Resort hotel, where the eclectic décor radiates a golden glow and offers magnificent views of Maastricht and the surrounding area. You can choose between an à la carte menu featuring fine ingredients and an appealing set menu (also vegan). The chefs navigate between familiar dishes such as steak tartare and more elaborate creations that playfully experiment with textures. Expect attention to presentation, a cosmopolitan touch here and there, and beautiful sauces. Hostess Jennifer provides excellent wine recommendations, with a preference for South African and German bottles....
